You should buy from **Seller A - Ottervale Audio**:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/9pfnz6/a

They're selling the exact same headphones for the exact same terms — with one important extra:

**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - Graphite**

|  | **A - Ottervale Audio** | **B - Brackmoor Sound** |
|---|---|---|
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Availability / Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days. | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days. |
| **Rating** | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. |
| **Warranty listed** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Dealer status** | **Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.** | No authorized-dealer claim listed |
| **Sold / shipped by** | Ottervale Audio | Brackmoor Sound |

### Why A?

Everything else is identical — same model, same specs, same price, same shipping time, same return policy, same rating.

The only difference is that Ottervale Audio explicitly states:

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

Brackmoor Sound does not claim to be authorized.

That matters for headphones because:
1. **Authenticity** - much lower risk of grey-market / counterfeit
2. **Warranty will actually be honored** - many manufacturers won't honor the 1-year warranty if you didn't buy from an authorized dealer

Since you pay the same $129 and get the same shipping and returns either way, there's no downside to picking the authorized dealer.
